rca:flags.text: Reference .cnv was processed with datcnv only; alignctd / celltm / loopedit are not applied.

The .cnv holds the downcast only (28725 scans, 23694 kept after removing ship-heave reversals). Bottle (.btl) averages are taken at upcast bottle closures, so CTD-vs-Autosal uses upcast data while profiler-vs-CTD uses the downcast.
Niskin 18 (367) is flagged by the cruise (Leaking; Acceptable; sample processed according to SOP) and is left out of the CTD-vs-Autosal check.
Niskin 21 (368, ~21 m depSM, sal00): CTD-bottle -0.1176 PSU is more than 0.01 PSU from the median; CTD gradient there -0.020 PSU/m.
Niskin 2 (362, ~560 m depSM, sal11): CTD-bottle -0.0156 PSU is more than 0.01 PSU from the median; CTD gradient there +0.000 PSU/m.
Niskin 21 (368, ~21 m depSM, sal11): CTD-bottle -0.1168 PSU is more than 0.01 PSU from the median; CTD gradient there -0.026 PSU/m.
Autosal workbook header date is 2020-10-27 but the cast is on 2021-08-26; looks like a template leftover (not changed).
Autosal workbook Calc!D55 says '2000'; cruise year is 2021 (not changed).
